beads.title: Unify core providers and extract neuroim4s, neuroatlas4s, mvpa4s and neurosurf4s
beads.body:
Outcome: ScalaFIM focuses on functional neuroimaging. Move neuroimaging volume/transform/display policy to ../neuroim4s, atlas semantics/catalogs/realizations to ../neuroatlas4s, MVPA to ../mvpa4s, and neuro-surface semantics/display to ../neurosurf4s over existing ../mesh4s. All four repository extractions are in scope.

Design: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md, baseline 86b3acf1e64d762be99b52ae146fa115b9050356. The plan owns architecture; these tasks define executable cutovers and acceptance.

Shared rules and acceptance:
- Concentrate generic abstractions in locus4s, image4s, spatial4s, mesh4s, reframe4s, Ravel, Gale, graph4s, Multivar, Resample4s, Alder and Intaglio where their contracts fit. Use existing APIs or extend their owner; domain repositories must not become new copies of generic infrastructure.
- Higher-level types add enforceable domain invariants or policy. Preserve provider representations and ownership; do not wrap/re-export an API merely to rename it.
- Image and surface cores are siblings. Share a small anatomical-declarations artifact (proposed neuroim4s-spaces, hosted in neuroim4s) without volume/IO/view dependencies. Volume-surface projection, hybrid routing and linked views are optional integrations above the two cores. Atlas core/catalog queries require neither image nor surface runtimes.
- Migrate known callers and delete replaced implementations at each cutover. Providers/extracted libraries have no ScalaFIM dependency, including test-source dependencies. Keep platform and optional dependencies explicit.
- Preserve ordering, identity, distinct provenance meanings, persisted schemas/digests, scientific behavior and scoped/allocation contracts. A package move does not rename wire identifiers.
- Run affected portable tests on JVM and JS; retain platform-native visual checks separately. Record exact revisions/outcomes and preserve existing caveats or adverse evidence.

Epic acceptance: U0-U6 plus I1 and A1 gates satisfied; all four libraries have independent clean consumers; ScalaFIM workflows use coherent immutable pins; old image/surface/atlas/MVPA implementations and duplicate authorities are gone; documentation and CI match the resulting dependency graph. Publication is a separate action.

Scheduling follows explicit prerequisites, not milestone numbers. MVPA core does not wait for imaging; atlas semantic core does not wait for either renderer; mesh and volume work can overlap. Leave tasks unassigned until implementation starts.

Related prior work to reconcile in U0: native image bd-01KYNR99SWCFEW94T4JGD9QPBS; unified MVPA bd-01M2BMGRP4MSM0RRRKNTHM0H4K; spatial transforms bd-01M39Q2YNKRTJTD8PZ4694DS52; mesh integration bd-01KYT2FD73TC4X1SC10HB5NCW3. Tracker status was unavailable while another agent restored authority. Reuse completed evidence. Update the already imported epic in place. Existing U0-U6 issue IDs are retained; I1 and A1 add neuroim4s and neuroatlas4s milestones. The payload describes the complete desired state and is not an idempotent update command.

beads.title: U0 milestone: Freeze ownership and deletion decisions for all four libraries
beads.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- Every moved public concept has one provider/domain owner, real consumers, replacement/deletion entry and compatibility decision.
- Spatial Domain/SpaceRef, compilers, runtimes and IO have explicit destinations; shared anatomical declarations have a minimal artifact with no volume or surface runtime dependency.
- Provenance packaging and mesh admission are settled; existing baselines/fixtures are assigned; graph is acyclic. This is a bounded contract review, not an extended audit.

Close after child implementation tasks satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md. The numbered gates do not serialize unrelated tasks.

beads.title: U1 milestone: Unify identity and provenance; free MVPA core
beads.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- Response and MVPA consume the same external source-provenance contract.
- MVPA core uses provider domains/maps and has no response or pipeline dependency.
- Owner/alignment, coordinate order, unique selection versus repeated draw, persistence and lineage regressions pass on JVM and JS.

Close after its child implementation tasks and their evidence satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md.

beads.title: U2 milestone: Share coordinate types and lightweight anatomical declarations
beads.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- Volume and mesh use the same spatial4s nominal frame types without competing frame algebra or registry.
- An independently usable anatomical-declarations artifact serves image/surface/atlas consumers without pulling volume operations, IO, transforms, display or ScalaFIM.
- Generic directional transforms remain in reframe4s; coherent provider pins pass frame/unit/convention/direction and scanner/tkRAS oracles.

Close after child implementation tasks satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md. The numbered gates do not serialize unrelated tasks.

beads.title: I1 milestone: Extract neuroim4s over core image and coordinate providers
beads.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- Volume/series refinements, neuroimaging IO policy, toolkit transforms and volume spatial policy live in neuroim4s; generic helpers live in their core providers.
- Independent image IO -> typed transform -> slice display works with optional platform backends; core has no surface/atlas/MVPA/ScalaFIM dependency.
- Native provider representation, value/axis semantics, canonical ordering, affine/scaling and bounded IO survive; replaced ScalaFIM image/transform/view sources are deleted.

Close after child implementation tasks satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md. The numbered gates do not serialize unrelated tasks.

beads.title: U3 milestone: Make surface geometry native to mesh4s
beads.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- One mesh topology/domain authority supports alternate realizations and fields, with no duplicate ScalaFIM topology.
- Exact vertex/face order and explicit strict/raw admission are preserved; no silent repair, renumbering or new full-mesh copies.
- Surface/atlas/spatial scientific fixtures and primitive renderer buffer contracts pass on JVM/JS. Mesh work does not require a volume viewer.

Close after child implementation tasks satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md. The numbered gates do not serialize unrelated tasks.

beads.title: U4 milestone: Extract standalone mvpa4s and migrate functional-analysis callers
beads.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- mvpa4s core/predictive build without ScalaFIM or required image/surface/atlas dependencies; imaging adapters are optional.
- Fit/dataset/group/artifact integrations remain thin ScalaFIM consumers of the extracted revision.
- Prediction/RSA, preparation/exposure, resampling, dense/operator, normalization and lifetime evidence survives; replaced core code is deleted. Optional surface/atlas measurement completion follows in U6.

Close after child implementation tasks satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md. The numbered gates do not serialize unrelated tasks.

beads.title: U5 milestone: Extract neurosurf4s with optional volume integration
beads.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- Neuro-surface core, formats and basic display build over mesh4s/locus4s/spatial4s/shared declarations without the neuroim4s volume stack or ScalaFIM.
- Projection and hybrid routing consume neuroim4s through optional modules; no core-to-integration or reverse volume-core dependency exists.
- Independent ingestion -> scalar display -> picking/readback and optional volume projection preserve actual CPU/native/browser evidence. Old surface/runtime/display implementations are deleted.

Close after child implementation tasks satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md. The numbered gates do not serialize unrelated tasks.

beads.title: A1 milestone: Extract neuroatlas4s catalogs, realizations and routes
beads.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- Atlas reference/version metadata, labels, hierarchies and catalog queries work independently of volume/surface runtimes, rendering and ScalaFIM.
- Optional volume and surface adapters use locus4s assignments/fields and shared world declarations; generic reductions and parcellations have one provider owner.
- Independent volume/surface query, reduction and routing preserve domain order, unknown/background policy, source assets and publication provenance; old ScalaFIM atlas code is deleted.

Close after child implementation tasks satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md. The numbered gates do not serialize unrelated tasks.

beads.title: U6 milestone: Admit all four libraries and remove remaining duplication
beads.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- neuroim4s, neurosurf4s, neuroatlas4s and mvpa4s have independent clean consumers on coherent immutable provider pins.
- All seven plan section 7 workflow families pass with explicit results; optional adapters preserve independent core dependency budgets.
- ScalaFIM retains functional-analysis policy/composition. Replaced authorities, expired facades and old implementations are deleted; docs/build aliases/bounded CI reflect the delivered graph.

Close after child implementation tasks satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md. The numbered gates do not serialize unrelated tasks.

beads.title: U0: Settle provider/domain ownership and the deletion map
beads.body:
Scope: Four extraction repositories; ScalaFIM image/transform/spatial/atlas/MVPA/surface; core providers.

Deliverable: Freeze concept ownership and actual consumer boundaries. Reconcile existing completed work; split every mixed spatial public declaration/runtime/IO adapter. Confirm lightweight shared anatomical declarations and source provenance packaging.

Acceptance:
- Every moved concept has one owner; generic arrays/axes/domains/maps/fields/frames/topology/solvers are assigned to core libraries, not duplicated in domain repos.
- Anatomical spaces artifact has no volume or surface runtime dependencies; volume, surface and atlas cores can be consumed independently.
- Spatial partition, strict/raw mesh input policy, private-access changes, external callers and persisted identifier compatibility are explicit in an acyclic deletion map.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.

beads.title: U0: Capture existing contracts and composition specimens
beads.body:
Scope: Current image/transform/atlas/MVPA/surface/provider tests, fixtures, examples and docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md.

Deliverable: Map the existing test corpus to destinations and capture the smallest current baseline per boundary. Define three shared-contract composition specimens: domain/duplicate draw, volume plus mesh frame, and response-to-MVPA provenance.

Acceptance:
- Each moved fixture/tool has one destination; all seven workflow families in plan section 7, external consumers and current failures/caveats are listed.
- Baseline commands and revisions are recorded with real exit outcomes; no new performance or scientific qualification is implied.
- Target specimens specify expected results and current provider gaps; provider-only tests cannot import ScalaFIM.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.

Acceptance:
- Independent restore/alignment, wrong-owner rejection and coordinate-order sensitivity pass on JVM/JS.
- Unique selections remain distinct from repeated occurrences/resampling draws; map composition preserves ordering.
- Global registry behavior is replaced or explicitly bounded; migrated callers have no second domain authority.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.

Acceptance:
- One production implementation owns IDs, roots, parent references and validation; response and MVPA exchange it directly.
- Missing parents, duplicate IDs/roots, source binding and persistence/digest framing have JVM/JS evidence.
- Unknown evidence stays unknown; lineage does not stand in for access permission, numerical value identity or statistical independence.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.

Acceptance:
